title: Text normalisation and sanitisation across write paths
summary: Make every shareable write sanitize before NFC normalization and repair stored rows and derived indexes safely.

specReferences.heading: W18 · Text normalisation and sanitisation across write paths

produces: Normalization skip records and fingerprinted completion marker
Derived-index rebuild and standing write-routing guard

conditions: Sanitization precedes NFC normalization on every relevant path.
The corrected repair reruns over rows processed by the earlier ordering.
Collisions, retries, restore, and derived-index rebuilding preserve data.
The structural routing guard is mutation-proven and transferred to W17.
completion.summary: Shareable writes sanitize before NFC normalization, and the versioned repair safely revisits earlier rows while preserving collisions, retries, restore, and derived indexes.
evidence: PR #1119: repository write choke points, collision-safe resumable backfill, skip records, derived-index rebuilding, and the mutation-proven structural routing guard.
PR #1124: schema v30 removes normalisation_skips.target_value so retries re-derive targets from live values.
PR #1137 (merge c855848c08e368039590ca8f3788f88ee5088b7b): sanitize-before-NFC ordering and the version 2 repair marker revisit rows processed by the former algorithm.

packages/compendium_core/test/storage/shareable_text_test.dart, normalisation_test.dart, and normalisation_structure_test.dart cover transform order, rerun, collisions, retries, restore-safe metadata, derived rebuilding, and the routing guard transferred to W17.
